name: Next Geosolutions Europe SpA
summary: Next Geosolutions Europe SpA provides marine geoscience and offshore construction support services in Europe, Asia, and North America. It offers desktop studies; survey services; pre-engineering survey services; offshore construction and installation support; inspection; repair and maintenance services; and turnkey solutions. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Napoli, Italy. Next Geosolutions Europe SpA operates as a subsidiary of Marnavi Spa.
